name: Alpha Depth Fog Volumetric
description: Seven depth layers accumulate turbulent Beer-Lambert fog with a live warm-to-cool temperature range, audio-lit scattering, held-pointer clearing, and click-driven vortices.
feedbackPacking: A/C = final ACES fogged display RGB and Beer-Lambert transmittance in alpha via bounded exact temporal loads; B is unused

name: Alpha HDR Bloom Chain
description: Temporal spectral HDR bloom with multi-ring dispersion, exposure-preserving feedback, audio-shaped radiance, held-pointer halos, and expanding click flashes.
feedbackPacking: A/C = raw HDR RGB and overexposure in alpha via bounded exact temporal loads; writeTexture alone is ACES tone-mapped; B is unused

name: Alpha Luminance History
description: Temporal luminance history with RGB plus rolling luminance in alpha. Slider-controlled diffusion, directional history advection, traveling click rings, and mouse painting create bounded light trails and warm afterimages.

name: Alpha Multi-Layer Glass
description: Multi-layer glass stack: three refracting panes with their own surfaces and parallax, frosted scatter, Fresnel, chromatic aberration and green Beer-Lambert pane edges. Alpha stores accumulated transmittance.

name: Alpha Spectral Decompose
description: Decomposes the image into 4 spectral frequency bands stored in RGBA. Low freq (R), mid-low (G), mid-high (B), high freq/detail (A). Recomposes with user-controlled per-band gain for frequency-equalizer style image manipulation.

name: Anaglyph 3D
description: Red-cyan anaglyph 3D with occlusion-aware stereo from depth, filter crosstalk on edges, a shimmering focal plane at the mouse depth, plus film grain, vignette and grading.

name: Anamorphic Caustic Flare
description: Cinematic anamorphic lens flare combined with living water caustics that refract the source footage along the caustic slope. Caustic peaks are squeezed into short horizontal glints whose length follows Caustic Stretch, matching the flare's anamorphic look. Bass stretches the flare and glints, treble brightens the caustics, and clicks fire local horizontal flare bursts. Mouse tilts the virtual lens.

name: ASCII Shockwave
description: Matrix glyph cells with traveling shock packets, held-pointer ASCII density, bounded click rings, and oil-slick phosphor color. Display RGBA is packed in A.

name: Breathing Kaleidoscope
description: Organic breathing kaleidoscope driven by domain-warped FBM, fractional symmetry, jewel-tone palette cycling, film grain, and depth-aware sector fading.
Rotational RGB splitting effect centered on the mouse.
name: Chroma Vortex
Chromatic Focus
description: Chromatic DOF with six-blade iris geometry, multi-tap blur, zone-plate caustics, oil-slick runners/packets, held focus squeeze/pinch, click iris shells, and light display history in A.

name: Spectral Bloom HDR
description: Crossover shader combining spectral dispersion with HDR bloom using RGBA as independent spectral bands. Decomposes the image into wavelength channels and applies per-band bloom with exposure control in alpha.

name: CRT Clear Zone
description: CRT screen with a clear window at the cursor: slot mask, visible beam raster, corner misconvergence, glass halation, and purity blotches around the rim that wobble when you click to degauss.

name: Cyber Physical Portal
description: Upgraded cyber portal with event-horizon frame dragging, gravitational lensing, accretion disk bands, cyan-magenta holographic rim, chromatic aberration, and HDR bloom. Bass drives spin, mouse positions portal, depth controls lensing.

name: Cyber Scan
description: Cyber scanner: triple scan beams with LIDAR depth contours, a live range readout, hex-grid data, binary rain and an afterimage trail, colored warm or cool by depth.

name: Elastic Chromatic
description: Elastic chromatic aberration with radial RGB shift, per-channel temporal lag, Lissajous mouse source, depth-aware audio reactivity, split-tone blackbody grading, ACES tone mapping, IGN dither and advanced layered alpha compositing.

params.name: Elasticity
params.description: Elastic spring constant for chromatic lag

name: Electric Contours
description: Electric field line tracing with equipotential surfaces, capped click spark charges from ripples, held mouse charge boost, corona bloom packets, FFT band arcs, and treble sparkle. Display is ACES-tonemapped; A stores raw field diagnostics (potential, |E|, edge/spark, dielectric energy).

params.name: Glow Intensity
params.description: Intensity multiplier for the electric glow

params.name: Field Line Density
params.description: Density of field and equipotential lines

name: Glitch Pixel Sort
description: Luminance-based pixel stretching controlled by mouse position.

name: Hex Circuit
description: Overlays a cybernetic hexagonal grid that highlights image edges and reacts to mouse pulses.

name: Holographic Flicker
description: Unstable laser hologram: mode-hopping laser lines with matching fringes, per-channel phosphor trails, vertical-hold slips and a rotating hex emblem.

name: Holo Projection Prism gpt52
description: Prismatic volume hologram with Bragg diffraction physics, stabilized focus, scan interference, and spectral tinting.

name: Holo Projector
description: Hologram projection with laser speckle, rainbow Bragg colour that shifts with viewing angle, and a rolling refresh band. Move the mouse to focus and stabilize it.

name: Holographic Sticker
description: Mouse-centered iridescent foil sticker with chromatic view-angle dispersion, grating ripple and rim highlight, embossed guilloche security rosettes whose hue slides as the sticker tilts across the screen, and an edge peel while the pointer is held that curls back the outer rim to show the white paper backing with a soft shadow on the image beneath. Click rainbow rings, audio-driven sticker pulse and hue-banded bass/mid/treble foil brightness, depth-layered alpha, subtle temporal shimmer.

name: Hyper Space Jump
description: Continuous relativistic streak integration combines a Doppler palette, helical flight, a movable vanishing point, held acceleration, and age-bounded jump shocks.
feedbackPacking: A/C = ACES display RGBA for continuous relativistic trails; B is unused; effect depth remains cleared to zero.

name: Interactive Fresnel
description: 2.5D Fresnel lens curvature with Cauchy dispersion, held ring squeeze, oil-slick grout, radial packets, and bounded click shells. Display RGBA in A.

name: Interactive PCB Traces
description: Coherent Manhattan routes connect pads and vias while signal packets, persistent trace glow, pointer injection, held drive, and click propagation animate the board.
feedbackPacking: A/C = ACES display RGBA for persistent signal glow; B is unused; source depth passes through.

name: Kinetic Echo
description: Chromatic R-lag / B-lead streaks with curl-advected exact-C trails. Trail Decay, luma gate, color shift, and mouse eraser stay live. ACES display history with trail-energy alpha.

name: Neon Edge Glow
description: Gas discharge tube simulation with accurate neon emission spectrum, AC rectification flicker, mercury vapor secondary lines, electrode sputtering, and atmospheric haze. Bass drives flicker frequency, mouse bends the tube, depth controls atmospheric scatter.

name: Neon Edge Pulse
description: Five mirrored zoom layers centred on the pointer, each outlined by neon edges that pulse inward with the bass; hold to spin the tunnel.

name: Neon Edge Reveal
description: Neon edge reveal: edges glow as neon tubes with hot cores and halos, a flashlight beam reveals the photo underneath, and lit edges burn in after the beam moves on.
Renders the image as a glowing 3D topographic map.
name: Neon Topology
Phantom Lag
description: Creates trailing echoes of movement with chromatic multi-tap delays, spring-damper bass smoothing, and velocity-stretched cursor ghosts.

name: Pixel Sorter
description: Glitch art pixel sorting with alpha translucency blending. Single sort pass with spectral tinting, depth-aware compositing, and audio-reactive shimmer.

name: Quantum Field Visualizer
description: Complex wavefunction visualization with real/imaginary parts mapped to hue, probability density to brightness, and phase to saturation. Features two-slit interference, Gaussian packet spreading, and mouse-driven quantum measurement collapse.

name: Quantum Ghost
description: Quantum ghost: radial ghost copies with double-slit fringes where they overlap, wave packets re-emitted from the cursor, and click collapse that snaps the ghosts back.
RGB split that grows with distance from the cursor: a 7-wavelength rainbow fringe plus faint diffraction-grating ghosts far from the pointer.
name: RGB Distance Split
RGB Topology
description: Topographic contour extraction per RGB channel with index isolines, ridge ticks, traveling iso-runners, psychedelic hypsometric ramps, held shear, and bounded click fronts. Feedback A stays [lineR, lineG, lineB, alpha].

name: Signal Modulation
description: AM/FM carrier wave with sprung origin, held widen, capped click carrier bursts, honest regional FFT spectral bands, ACES composite.

params.name: Rain Angle Scale
params.description: Scale of the rain angle variation

name: Spectral Rain
description: Falling streaks of chromatic distortion with audio-reactive intensity and mouse-driven angle and speed controls.

name: Temporal RGB Smear
description: Directional RGB smear with curl-noise velocity field, domain-warped drift, Halton-jittered chromatic sampling, temporal feedback decay, ACES tone mapping, and advanced layered alpha compositing (luminance key, edge preserve, effect intensity, depth layer, accumulative trails).

params.name: Chromatic Split
params.description: RGB channel separation along smear direction

params.name: Turbulence
params.description: Strength of curl-noise and domain-warp turbulence

name: Time Slit Scan
description: Multi-slit temporal scan with curved parametric slits, polar drift, and time-warp color tinting.

name: Voxel Grid
description: Transforms the image into a grid of rotating 3D voxels that react to mouse proximity and audio bass.

name: Warp Drive
description: Alcubierre warp streaks with Doppler aurora packets, held warp aim, analytic stars, click fronts. Diagnostic A packing preserved.

name: Zipper Reveal
description: Mechanical zipper with interlocking tooth simulation, fabric physics, metallic specular highlights, and chromatic aberration on fast-moving teeth. Bass drives zipper speed and mouse controls pull position.

params.name: Spread
params.description: Width of the zipper V-shape opening
